retrievalProfile.description: Use for high-octane action media featuring an ensemble cast standing in front of vehicles with heavy metallic 3D title treatments.

recipe.visualDefinition: A wide-angle cinematic composition featuring a diverse group of characters in heroic stances, flanked by high-performance vehicles against a bright urban skyline, anchored by massive chrome-textured typography in the foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: Characters arranged in a shallow V-formation to create depth
Vehicles positioned behind characters to frame the central group
Bright, hazy sky contrasting with dark, textured asphalt ground
Large-scale typography overlapping the lower third of the image
coreInvariants: Chrome or brushed metal texture on primary title text
Low-angle perspective on characters to emphasize scale
High-contrast lighting with strong rim highlights on figures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Ensemble cast occupies the middle ground, scaled to fill the horizontal width; title text dominates the bottom foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central character and the large metallic '6' in the bottom left-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright sky, move down through the character faces, and settle on the heavy metallic title at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open sky in the top third provides breathing room for secondary metadata text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool grays and blues in the sky and asphalt
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and shadows in character clothing and car tires
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Saturated red and blue from the featured vehicles
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the background sky, low value in the foreground ground, with punchy saturation on the cars.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a gritty, desaturated urban palette

letterConstructionRules: Heavy horizontal shearing for a sense of speed
Deep 3D extrusion with a downward perspective
Beveled edges with high-specular chrome reflections
characterSpecificRedesigns: The numeral is significantly larger than the text, acting as a secondary anchor
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy 3D display type paired with a clean, wide-tracked sans-serif for secondary info.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and aggressive stance

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic wide shot of an ensemble cast standing heroically in front of a red muscle car and a blue sports car on a dark asphalt road. The background should feature a bright, hazy London-style skyline under a daylight sky. Use low-angle lighting with strong rim highlights on the characters.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, 3D metallic chrome title in an extra-bold italic sans-serif font across the bottom third. Add a secondary line of black, wide-tracked sans-serif text at the very top center.

verificationChecks: Is the title text metallic and 3D?
Are the characters in a heroic ensemble pose?
Is the horizon line placed to allow for sky text?
Does the lighting feel cinematic and high-contrast?

adjustableVariables: Number of characters in the ensemble
Specific city skyline in the background
mustRedesign: Do not use existing film franchise logos
Ensure the 'Parental Advisory' style mark is genericized

mustAchieve: Seamless compositing of characters into the environment
Consistent perspective between characters and cars
avoid: Cluttered background that obscures the cast

postGenerationChecks: Check that the 3D text perspective matches the ground plane
Verify that the chrome texture has realistic environment reflections
Ensure the ensemble cast is balanced across the frame
Confirm the top metadata text is legible against the sky
recipe.reuseFormula: Ensemble Cast + Heroic Vehicles + Urban Skyline + 3D Metallic Typography = Action Cinematic Aesthetic
